decision.reason: the sector layer had no stable forward rank signal and the nested challenger failed five of six preregistered gates

research_scope.history: 2023-09-15 through 2026-06-18; development ended 2026-05-26 and the later 16 signal days were a diagnostic window
research_scope.execution: next unadjusted close to fifth trading close after entry with 10bp round-trip cost; missing sleeves held cash
research_scope.eligibility: main-board A-share prefixes only, unadjusted signal close at most CNY 200, tradable research proxy required, signal-day return below 9.5 percent, all applied before ranking
research_scope.baseline: exact active V3 trial-000 Top3 daily return from the frozen restricted study
research_scope.pit_rule: features used observations no later than the signal day and labels had to be fully observable before refitting
research_scope.claim_ceiling: same-history sequential mechanism research with provisional effective sector membership; not independent validation and not production-grade PIT

sector_layer.interpretation: the first-stage sector forecast was indistinguishable from random ranking overall and deteriorated in the latest half-year

stock_sector_relative_residual_layer.interpretation: the stock-level sector-relative target retained weak positive information, but it could not rescue an invalid sector gate

static_full_development_is_not_selection.warning: these fixed-arm aggregates use the same opened development history and every confidence interval still crosses zero

named_example_diagnostics.interpretation: the gate missed both requested recovery examples because it ranked electronics near the bottom; examples are diagnostic only

failure_ledger.direction: predict top sectors first, then choose one exact-core-led stock per selected sector
failure_ledger.finding: the top-down sector restriction removed useful stock opportunities without a stable sector forecast; nested selection frequently fell back to V3 and recent performance deteriorated sharply
failure_ledger.do_not_repeat: do not hard-gate the stock universe by a learned sector forecast on this reused history, and do not fit a V3 allocation switch around this challenger

next_research_hypothesis.why: the only surviving diagnostic signal was stock return residualized against its sector, not the forecasted sector rank
constraints: exact V3 core remains the primary score and lambda zero remains the control
sector information may neutralize or bound stock residuals but cannot exclude whole sectors
no same-window parameter rescue; freeze a new contract before any run
historical evidence remains exploratory until strict sector availability lineage and a new untouched period exist

retained_asset.claim_ceiling: deterministic provisional sector-state research input, not strict historical vendor-vintage PIT
